svg.title: gnu6.live cube alpha master — ratified compositing variant
svg.desc: Exact-fidelity SVG wrapper embedding the ratified alpha-channel PNG. The artwork is byte-identical to the opaque ratified master wherever alpha is 255. Not a vector-native reconstruction. Sanctioned for compositing on neutral substrates only per ID-004; over Signal Orange, Royal Blue or Beret Green use the opaque master.
